title: Stolen exchange funds peeled through new wallets and sold at the bank
summary: An attacker empties an exchange's wallets into a new address. One slice of the funds passes through a run of new wallets and is then sold through the bank's crypto service and sent on.

basis.note: A case follows one slice of the stolen funds. The slice is sized so that a personal customer could sell it through a bank's crypto service, and its range is assumed.

references.note: The report describes one theft from an exchange whose proceeds investigators followed through peel chains and accounts at several exchanges.
